All five correction scenarios and tasks correspond on paper 10–11: journal 52, suspense 6, corrected profit 14, balance sheet 20 and commission-error example/explanation 8. The example is open; no optional scenario is offered. English scheme 19–21.

Service-business reserves 18, shop profit 10, profit/loss 32, balance sheet 30 and financing advice 10 correspond on paper 12–13. The extension-finance advice is open, not a finite choice pool. All eight adjustments are required. English scheme 22–25.

Both (a) marginal-cost scenarios and (b) Aldridge accounts are required on paper 14–15. High/low 8, break-even 13, safety margin 5, target units 14, revised profit 14, semi-fixed example 4, combined marginal/absorption accounts 14 and comparison 8 correspond. No alternative answer route; English scheme 26–29.
